name: Calcite Seep
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-13: Thick as Thieves
description: A seep of mineral-rich water coats any unattended objects in a layer of calcite.
disable: DC 20 Performance check (trained) to shatter the calcite using the resonant powers of the consonite crystals plus DC 20 Athletics check, DC 20 Nature check, or DC 20 Survival check (trained) to dam the flow of water.

offensiveAbilities.name: Mineral Glaze
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger An unattended inanimate object enters the path of the calcite flow

Effect The object gains a thin shell of calcite. Breaking the shell using physical damage will harm the object underneath.
